units.poolKey: COMBINATION C4: a low rung on a working approach
units.spine: The town is poor, and nothing about the place hides it.

units.poolKey: INCOME MIX: one source carries the town
units.spine: One trade carries the town's living, and it reaches households that never work in it directly.

units.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
units.spine: The same carts that carry goods out bring goods back in, so the town knows both sides of its trade.
Warmholz sells more than one thing outward, and no single line carries the whole trade. Losing one line would not end it.
The town takes in a little more food than it eats.
Salt is worked here, though none of it is raised on Warmholz ground. It is bought in as feedstock, the way another trade might grow its own instead.
